resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package (ORCA, NWChem, or PySCF)

access.notes: ORCA download and documentation. Alternatives: NWChem (https://nwchemgit.github.io) and PySCF (https://github.com/pyscf/pyscf).

resources.notes: Any of these can perform B3LYP/6-31G(d,p) geometry optimization, frequency calculation, and Mulliken population analysis. The paper originally used Gaussian 09; the reproduction is rescoped to an open‑source equivalent.
